angle: 'The day I stopped dieting and started planning'
slides: POV: your weight won't stop going up and down
For years I ate badly. No system, no plan.
I felt bad all the time. Heavy. Tired. Not me.
Too much weight. Then too little. Then too much again.
Nothing stuck. So I built myself a simple plan.
Real food. Protein in every meal. That's it.
Now I feel amazing. And I actually enjoy eating.
I turned it into a free grocery list. Link in bio.
caption: I didn't need more willpower. I needed a plan. Free high-protein grocery list → link in bio
yt_title: I didn't need willpower, I needed a plan #shorts
threads:
For years my weight swung up and down and I felt bad all the time.

What fixed it wasn't a diet. It was a simple plan: real food, protein in every meal.

Now I feel amazing. Anyone else been on that rollercoaster?
